targets.rawSql:
WITH tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')) IN (
  SELECT tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key'))
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
    AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
) AS is_sam2_prediction
SELECT
  concat(anyIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name'), JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name') != ''), ' (#', toString(task_id), ')') AS Video,
  anyIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'device'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference') AS Device,
  anyIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'model_id'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference') AS Model,
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS "Successful runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'failed') AS "Failed runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Inferred frames",
  countIf(scope = 'confirm:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'previous_source') = 'auto') AS "Accepted unchanged",
  uniqExactIf(tuple(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')), scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "Corrected frames",
  countIf(scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "Correction sessions",
  round(if("Inferred frames" = 0, 0, "Corrected frames" * 100.0 / "Inferred frames"), 1) AS "Correction rate",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.5)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'), 1) AS "P50 latency",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'), 1) AS "P95 latency",
  maxIf(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Maximum latency",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'initialize'), 1) AS "P95 initialization"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask', 'confirm:mask')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY task_id
HAVING "Inferred frames" > 0 OR "Successful runs" > 0 OR "Failed runs" > 0
ORDER BY "Inferred frames" DESC

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(duration), 1) AS "Client P50",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration), 1) AS "Client P95",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server P50",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server P95",
  max(duration) AS "Client maximum"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

WITH tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')) IN (
  SELECT tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key'))
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
    AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
) AS is_sam2_prediction
SELECT
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS "Successful runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'failed') AS "Failed runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Inferred frames",
  countIf(scope = 'confirm:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'previous_source') = 'auto') AS "Accepted unchanged",
  uniqExactIf(tuple(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')), scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "Corrected frames",
  countIf(scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "Correction sessions",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'initialize'), 1) AS "P95 initialization"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask', 'confirm:mask')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))

SELECT
  timestamp AS Time,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name') AS Video,
  JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame') AS Frame,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'direction') AS Direction,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'device') AS Device,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'model_id') AS Model,
  JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_count') AS Objects,
  duration AS Latency,
  JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms') AS "Server latency",
  round(JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'state_bytes') / 1048576, 2) AS "State MiB"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  concat(any(JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name')), ' (#', toString(task_id), ')') AS Video,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Inferred frames",
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'context_frames')) AS "Instrumented frames",
  round(avgOrNullIf(least(greatest(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'context_frames') - 1, 0), 6), JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'context_frames')), 1) AS "Average previous frames used",
  maxOrNullIf(least(greatest(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'context_frames') - 1, 0), 6), JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'context_frames')) AS "Maximum previous frames used",
  maxOrNullIf(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'context_frames'), JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'context_frames')) AS "Maximum frames since anchor",
  maxOrNullIf(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'distance_from_anchor'), JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'distance_from_anchor')) AS "Maximum anchor distance",
  round(countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'session_reused') AND JSONExtractBool(payload, 'session_reused')) * 100.0 / nullIf("Instrumented frames", 0), 1) AS "Session reuse rate",
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'correct') AS "Correction reinitializations"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY task_id
HAVING "Inferred frames" > 0
ORDER BY "Inferred frames" DESC

WITH tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')) IN (
  SELECT tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key'))
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
    AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
) AS is_sam2_prediction
SELECT
  user_id AS "User ID",
  user_name AS User,
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS "Successful SAM2 runs",
  uniqExactIf(tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')), scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "SAM2 corrected frames",
  countIf(scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) AS "SAM2 correction sessions",
  countIf(scope = 'confirm:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'previous_source') = 'auto') AS "SAM2 accepted unchanged",
  sumIf(if(JSONHas(payload, 'count'), JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'count'), 1), scope IN ('draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object')) AS "Annotations created"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask', 'confirm:mask', 'draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object')
  AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY user_id, user_name
HAVING "Successful SAM2 runs" > 0 OR "SAM2 correction sessions" > 0 OR "SAM2 accepted unchanged" > 0 OR "Annotations created" > 0
ORDER BY "SAM2 correction sessions" DESC, "Annotations created" DESC

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'decode_ms')), 1) AS "Image decode",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'preprocess_cpu_ms')), 1) AS "Preprocess CPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'state_load_ms')), 1) AS "State load",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'encoder_gpu_ms')), 1) AS "Encoder GPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms')), 1) AS "Tracker GPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(greatest(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_wall_ms') - JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms'), 0)), 1) AS "Tracker CPU and postprocess",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'state_save_ms')), 1) AS "State save"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'encoder_gpu_ms')
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
